A stakeholder can ask the TSP or raise the constraint in the RPG; it cannot order it.
battery_owner_role: A battery owner can submit the upgrade to the RPG (any stakeholder, NP 3.11.4.1) and can pay for a TSP-elected, resource-funded project (NP 3.11.4.11), but cannot own, order or schedule network upgrades. Under connect-and-manage it pays its own interconnection facilities above a $14M (138 kV or less) / $20M (above 138 kV) allowance (16 TAC 25.195(f)(3)); the TSP pays network upgrades. No PUCT or ERCOT rule lets a TSP buy transmission-level storage in place of a line: PURA 35.153 (SB 415) covers distribution reliability only, bars TDU ownership and caps contracts at 100 MW (rule 16 TAC 25.58 proposed in Project 59523); ERCOT's planning compares wires alternatives and dispatch of existing resources (PG 3.1.2.1, 3.1.3, 4.1.1.2), and a RAS or CMP cannot be a permanent fix (PG 4.1.1.2(2)(a)).
